_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: one row, the candidate's own 'Personal Contribution' of 947.20 on 1/2/24, equal to the cover's stated contribution total to the cent. This is a wholly self-funded filing: the single contribution exactly funds the three expenses.

expenditures.detail: three rows summing 754.95 + 157.93 + 34.32 = 947.20, equal to the cover's stated expenditure total to the cent, and each row independently corroborated by its attached receipt on pp4-6.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: NEITHER schedule page prints its own section total on this filing (the 2024 single_total form leaves the total to the cover), so the gate is the COVER, and both sides close on it exactly: expenditures 754.95 + 157.93 + 34.32 = 947.20 = the stated 947.20; contributions the single row 947.20 = the stated 947.20; and the cover's own balance is the zero-glyph 'O with a slash' (already in the cover cache), consistent with contributions == expenditures. A SECOND, independent gate exists here and is unusual for this corpus: pages 4-6 are the filer's attached SOURCE RECEIPTS, one per expense row, and each reproduces its ledger amount and date to the cent - p4 the filer's own check #521 to Summit County Clerk dated 1/2/24 for $754.95 ('for: file for office', plus a sticky note reading 'Candidate Filing Fee $754.95'), p5 Richards Sign Company invoice 4791 dated 03/12/2024 totalling 157.93 (147.25 + 10.68 tax) with a matching Visa credit-sale slip, p6 a WinCo Foods register receipt dated 03/17/24 totalling 34.32 (33.32 + 1.00 food tax).

geometry.basis: rule-detection row banding (rowbands.py) on the page's own printed grid; box spans the full table width of the row

_meta_itemized.notes: PAGE POSITION IS NOT A CLASSIFIER, again: on this filing page 2 is the ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT and page 3 is the ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT - the reverse of the module's normal order. Both pages were classified by their own printed heading. The 2024 Summit form's contribution schedule has only three columns (Date | Name of Contributor | Amount) and NO address or city column at all, so donor_city/donor_state are honestly BLANK for structural reasons on this filing - nothing was redacted and nothing was left empty by the filer. No specimen rows survive on either page (the 'Jon and Jane Doe' / 'Name of Business' template rows are absent) and every remaining band on both schedules is a genuinely empty ruled line. The filer's hand is legible throughout; the only stylistic quirk is the superscripted cents on the first expense amount ('754.' with '95' raised), which the attached check on p4 confirms as 754.95. Pages 4-6 are receipt attachments, not schedules - they carry no transactions of their own and are recorded only as corroboration.
